keyVerseDR: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep." (Jn 10:11)

level1.title: The Good Shepherd
level1.story: Jesus said, "I am the Good Shepherd." A good shepherd gives his life for his sheep. Jesus knows us and loves us!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What does a good shepherd do?
How does Jesus take care of you?
level1.prayer: Good Shepherd, take care of me. Amen.

activity.title: Find the Shepherd
activity.intro: Help the little sheep find the Good Shepherd.

level2.title: I Lay Down My Life
level2.story: Jesus said, "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep." A hired man runs away when he sees the wolf coming, because he does not care for the sheep. Jesus said, "I know Mine, and Mine know Me." He said He has other sheep too, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd. Jesus said, "I lay down My life, that I may take it again."
level2.keyLine: The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is Jesus different from the hired man?
How can you help bring others to Jesus' flock?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Good Shepherd, I am Yours. Amen.

activity.title: A shepherd saint
activity.intro: Bishops and priests are shepherds. Write about a saint you want to be like.
starters: This saint cared for people by...
I want to be like this saint because...

art.mainBrief: Good Shepherd carrying a lamb; wolf far off
art.heartBrief: Little sheep in heart; staff on side
